desc:
Welcome to Sort a Music Shop! 🎶🎧

Have you ever dreamed of working in a cozy music store? Now is your chance! Your main goal is to keep everything perfectly organized and become the best employee in town. 🏆

📦 HOW TO PLAY:
• Walk around the store and collect scattered items.
• Correctly sort the vinyl records, CDs, DVDs, and retro cassettes.
• Place each item onto its matching shelf or section.
• Be fast, be accurate, and keep the shop looking spotless!

✨ FEATURES:
💿 Multiple music formats to sort and organize (Vinyl, CD, DVD, Cassette).
🎵 A relaxing and cozy store environment (Chill vibe).
🤝 Multiplayer fun – play with friends and race to see who can stock the shelves the fastest!

🏷️ Tags: Music Shop, Sorting, Simulator, Vinyl, CD, Cassette, DVD, Work, Job, Chill, Roleplay, Music Store, Organizin
